faqsSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqsSection.description: Everything you need to know about Fellow Notes, BSc I.T. study resources, AI tools, and plans.

faqs.question: What is Fellow Notes?
faqs.answer: Fellow Notes is a study platform made specifically for BSc I.T. students, offering notes, PYQs, quizzes, flashcards, summaries, and AI study tools in one place.

faqs.question: What AI tools are available?
faqs.answer: You can use AI chat with Gemini, generate topic-wise summaries, create quizzes and flashcards, and use AI tools to understand and revise your subjects faster.

faqs.question: What is included in the Pro plan?
faqs.answer: The Pro plan includes notes and PYQs along with Gemini AI chat, topic-wise summaries, AI-generated quizzes, and AI-generated flashcards.

faqs.question: What is included in the Max plan?
faqs.answer: The Max plan includes all Pro features plus Google NotebookLM video study support, advanced Gemini AI chat, a blue tick verified account, and early access to new features.

faqs.question: Can I study for exams the night before?
faqs.answer: Yes. Fellow Notes brings notes, PYQs, summaries, quizzes, flashcards, and AI tools together so you can quickly revise and prepare, even the night before an exam.
